title: How many archetypes should be identified?
question: Which k satisfies the pre-registered selection rule?
methodology: Rule set before viewing profiles: main setup fully_evolved/relative, k in 3-8; eligible only if silhouette > shuffled baseline p95, bootstrap ARI >= 0.6, smallest cluster >= 5%.
interpretation: No k qualified. k=5 came closest (ARI 0.591 vs 0.6 cutoff). The cutoff was not lowered after seeing results. Clusters are reported as descriptive partitions only.
limitations: 20 bootstrap resamples: ARI estimates carry noise of a few hundredths.
